newerCommits.few: After linking, {{count}} newer commits of {{source}} can be pushed to {{target}}.

newerCommits.other: After linking, {{count}} newer commits of {{source}} can be pushed to {{target}}.

app.notInitialized: Version control is not set up in {{name}} yet. Initializing creates the _pgvc schema and the DDL event triggers.
app.notInitializedNoSuperuser: Version control is not set up in {{name}} yet. Initializing creates the _pgvc schema and the DDL event triggers and needs a SUPERUSER connection.
app.welcomeTitle: Track your PostgreSQL schema like a git repository
app.welcomeText: Add a database connection to start. Every schema change becomes a commit you can push to other environments or export for an isolated site.
app.noCommitsReady: Change the schema in your IDE and the changes appear here as the working tree, or run a migration with New SQL Migration. The first commit records the current schema as the baseline.
app.noCommitsNotReady: Initialize version control in the active environment to start recording commits.
app.inspectorHint: Select the working tree to review and commit changes, or a commit to see its SQL, export it or roll back to it.
app.rollbackUnavailable: The active environment is not available
app.rollbackNotAncestor: Not an earlier commit of the history of {{name}}

audit.title: Live DDL Audit Log
audit.polling: Polling the event trigger log every 5 seconds
audit.empty: No DDL captured since the last commit.

workingTree.title: Working Tree
workingTree.hint: Generated from pg_catalog. Edit the SQL before committing if needed (for example add a USING clause). The changes are already in the database: committing records them, it does not execute anything.

commit.author: Author
commit.noChanges: This commit did not change the schema.
commit.noDdl: No DDL was captured by the event triggers for this commit.
commit.rollbackTitle: Revert the active environment to this commit
commit.deleteTitle: Delete this commit from the version history
commit.deleteBlocked: Used by the current history of {{envs}}. Roll back to an earlier commit first.
commit.exportSnapshotTitle: Export the schema of this commit as a reference snapshot (.pgsnap.json)

environments.title: Environments
environments.subtitle: Database connections are stored in pgvc-environments.json next to the application.
environments.name: Name
environments.hint: Version control tracks every user schema of the database; the default schema is only the search_path of the connection. Initializing version control needs a SUPERUSER (it installs DDL event triggers).
environments.notInitialized: Version control is not initialized in this database yet.
environments.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the list? The database itself is not changed.
environments.initialized: Version control initialized: schema _pgvc and DDL event triggers installed

migration.title: New SQL Migration (Mode B)
migration.subtitle: Runs on {{env}} in a single transaction; the resulting schema is recorded as a new commit.
migration.template:
-- UP SQL: executed in one transaction together with the commit.
-- If any statement fails, nothing is applied.
migration.allowDirty: Also include uncommitted changes that are already in the database

export.title: Export Offline .SQL
export.subtitle: A self-contained script for an isolated database: run it with psql or DBeaver.
export.footer: The script checks the target HEAD first; on any error nothing is applied.

rollback.title: Rollback {{env}} to {{hash}}
rollback.subtitle: The script runs in one transaction; the resulting schema must match the snapshot of the target commit.
rollback.warning: Reverts {{commits}} on {{env}}. Dropped tables and columns lose their data. The commits stay in the history; HEAD moves to {{hash}}.

sync.title: Sync / Push to Environment
sync.subtitle: Applies the missing commits of the source to the target in one transaction and verifies the result.
sync.allowDirty: Push even if the target has uncommitted changes
sync.targetDirty: The target schema has changes that are not committed there.

SAME.label: Up to date
SAME.text: Both environments are at the same commit.

TARGET_BEHIND.label: Behind
TARGET_BEHIND.text: The target is behind: the commits below can be pushed.

TARGET_EMPTY.label: Empty history
TARGET_EMPTY.text: Version control is set up in the target but it has no commits yet.

TARGET_NOT_INITIALIZED.label: Not initialized
TARGET_NOT_INITIALIZED.text: The target has no _pgvc schema yet; the push installs it first (needs a SUPERUSER).

TARGET_AHEAD.label: Ahead
TARGET_AHEAD.text: The target is ahead of the source: nothing to push.

DIVERGED.label: Diverged
DIVERGED.text: The histories are not connected (e.g. each environment was committed separately): the push is not possible.

link.title: Link {{target}} to the history of {{source}}
link.intro: {{target}} already has a schema. Linking records that it is at a commit of {{source}}: {{noSql}}, only its version history is replaced. Afterwards the newer commits can be pushed as usual.
link.noMatch: The schema of {{target}} does not match any commit of {{source}}. Choose the commit it should correspond to: linking shows the differences; bring the schemas in line or accept the differences explicitly.
link.allowDifferences: Link even if the schemas differ (the differences stay as uncommitted changes of {{target}})
link.keepOwn: Keep the previous commits of {{target}} (by default they are replaced)

about.licenseUnavailable: The license text is not bundled in this build. See the LICENSE file in the repository.

deletion.title: Delete {{hash}}
deletion.subtitle: Removes commits from the version history of every environment. The database schema is not changed.
deletion.modeCommitHint: The commit and every commit made on top of it.
deletion.modeBranchHint: Also the earlier commits of this abandoned branch, down to where it forked off a live history.
deletion.blocked: Cannot delete: the current history of {{envs}} uses these commits. Roll the environment back to an earlier commit first.
deletion.offline: Cannot delete while {{envs}} cannot be reached: it is unknown whether the commits are used there.
deletion.irreversible: This cannot be undone: the commits, their SQL and schema snapshots are removed permanently.

snapshot.title: External Snapshot Synchronization
snapshot.subtitle: Compares the live schema of {{env}} with a reference snapshot exported from another installation and applies the missing changes as one commit.
snapshot.dropHint: or choose it on disk. The file is read in the browser and compared with {{env}}; nothing changes until you apply.
snapshot.headerCommit: Comparing the current database {{env}} with the reference snapshot of commit {{hash}} (branch {{branch}})
snapshot.headerLive: Comparing the current database {{env}} with a reference snapshot of the live schema of {{source}}
snapshot.identical: The schema of {{env}} matches the reference snapshot: nothing to apply.
snapshot.versionMismatch: PostgreSQL versions differ ({{source}} → {{target}}): view definitions may be formatted differently and show up as modified.
snapshot.uncommitted: {{env}} has schema changes that are not committed (or no history yet). The new commit records the actual resulting schema.
snapshot.missingHint: Present in the snapshot, missing or different in this database. Selected by default.
snapshot.destructiveHint: Exist only in this database, not in the snapshot. Applying them DROPS the objects and their data — not selected by default.
snapshot.rebuilt: The SQL was rebuilt from the selection; manual edits were replaced.
snapshot.dropsSelected: {{count}} destructive change(s) selected: objects will be dropped.
